thread.title: YouTube Launches Lower-Priced Student Plans for Premium Services -- Update

author: morningstar.com
title: YouTube Launches Lower-Priced Student Plans for Premium Services -- Update

organizations.name: youtube launches lower-priced student plans for premium services

text:
By Josh Beckerman
YouTube, owned by Alphabet Inc.(GOOG, GOOGL), is offering lower-priced versions of two subscription plans for college students.
Monthly prices will be $4.99 for YouTube Music Premium and $6.99 for YouTube Premium.
The ad-free YouTube Red service launched in 2015 starting at $9.99 a month. In May, it was rebranded as the $11.99 YouTube Premium, while YouTube Music Premium, a competitor to Spotify Technology SA (SPOT) and Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) Apple Music, launched with a price of $9.99.
The new plans are available to full-time students at accredited U.S. colleges and universities, with verification by SheerID.
Write to Josh Beckerman at josh.beckerman@wsj.com
